notes.title: Release time adjustment notice
notes.notes: [p]Dear Steam players,[/p][p]The game [i]Local Mom is a Slut[/i], originally scheduled for release in Q2, is still undergoing final adjustments and translation work. To provide a more polished gameplay experience, we have decided to postpone the release to Q3 2025.[/p][p]Thank you for your support and patience. We will do our utmost to deliver the best possible game as soon as we can![/p]
